Reason for Mistake: Misinterpretation of gathered data and logical inversion in the final conclusion. The Planner correctly identified the release years (Bedknobs and Broomsticks: 1971, The Muppet Christmas Carol: 1992) in Step 4 but erroneously concluded that the film with the later release year (1992) was "older." This contradicts the fundamental definition of "older" (earlier release date) and represents a failure to apply the correct logical comparison to the verified facts.
